results.title: Expired .eth name re-registration without resolver leaves prior owner's resolver controlling resolution
results.test_command: MAINNET_RPC_URL=<mainnet rpc url> bun run test test/ExpiredNameNoResolverReRegistrationPoC.test.ts
results.notes: Mainnet fork PoC at block 25030187 passed. The ENS registry, BaseRegistrar, and controller addresses match deployments/mainnet. Assertions show the victim owns the NFT and registry node after no-resolver re-registration while the attacker-controlled stale resolver remains active and mutable.
